selection_rule: Promote the revision whose status is current_approved, whose approval applies to general inpatient care, and whose content hash matches the approval record. A limited-scope addendum is not a replacement for the general protocol.

revisions.content: Revision MAP-17-R9. Confirm two patient identifiers before administration. Reconcile the medication, dose, route, time, allergy record, renal adjustment, and active order. For concentrated potassium chloride, use pharmacy-prepared dilution and an infusion pump; the general inpatient maximum is 10 mEq per hour. A rate above 10 mEq per hour requires an ICU order, continuous cardiac monitoring, and pharmacist verification. Record the independent double-check for high-alert medicines and stop administration when the order, label, or patient record does not agree.

Emergency Department addendum: document weight obtained during resuscitation and the emergency-order identifier before weight-based administration. This addendum supplements MAP-17-R9 and does not replace it.

Revision MAP-17-R6. Confirm patient name and medication label. Concentrated potassium chloride may run at up to 20 mEq per hour on a general inpatient unit when an infusion pump is used. Record administration after completion.
